layout.label: PUC MINAS
layout.title: One website, three languages
layout.description: An internationalization example with i18next and react-i18next: click the flags and watch texts, plurals, dates, numbers and currencies change instantly, without reloading the page.
layout.footer: Teaching project · PUC Minas · React + Vite

simple.title: Plain text
simple.desc: Every text on the screen becomes a key. The component calls t("key") and gets the text in the current language.
simple.subtitle: This text is in English.

interpolation.title: Interpolation
interpolation.desc: Values that change (like a name) go into the text with {{variable}}. The word order can be different in each language.
interpolation.label: Your name
interpolation.greeting: Hi, {{name}}! Great to have you here.

plural.title: Plurals
plural.desc: Pass the count and i18next picks the right form: _zero, _one or _other (each language has its own rules).

format.title: Dates, numbers and currencies
format.desc: Formatting uses the browser's Intl API, following each language's conventions. The currency is chosen in each language's JSON (the amount is not converted).

trans.title: The <Trans> component
trans.desc: To translate a sentence with bold text, a link or another component in the middle, without breaking the sentence into pieces.
trans.text: Read the syllabus and submit your assignment on Canvas by Friday.

list.title: Lists and objects
list.desc: With returnObjects: true, the key returns an array (or object) from the JSON, ready for a .map().
steps: Click a flag to change the language
i18next saves your choice in localStorage
On your next visit, the site opens in the language you chose
With no saved choice, it uses the browser's language
